subject: Repeated Morphology for Individuals over Time

messages.author: e9bbf555ebd5899d
messages.subject: Repeated Morphology for Individuals over Time
parts:
Hi all!

I am working with a data set of repeat measures of morphometrics on 64 cutthroat trout. I have 4 different replicate measurements of the same 24 landmarks on these 64 fish. I am trying to closely examine how each individual changes in their shape over time relative to the mean, but I am struggling with using multiple levels of classifiers in my analysis and using the advanced.procD.lm function.

Does anyone have any advice for approaching the formatting of data for this problem? I am really sorry if this is a dumb/obvious question. I have primarily taught myself these methods and coding throughout my M.Sc.

Any advice is greatly appreciated!!

Thank you!
Taylor

messages.author: fbfd20ce829c6c6c
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Repeated Morphology for Individuals over Time
parts:
Hi Taylor, 

advanced.procD.lm has been deprecated. I advise you update your geomorph and RRPP packages:
https://github.com/geomorphR/geomorph
https://github.com/mlcollyer/RRPP

The vignette here has been supplied to assist users in running the analyses that were possible through advanced.procD.lm: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/geomorph/vignettes/geomorph.assistance.html.

Not a dumb question, and this list is to help people. I've found the help files and vignettes super useful but I'd also encourage you to reach out once you review them if you run into more problems.

Best,
Bryan
